changes.description: Fixed two test-code bugs identified by storefront-debug triage

fixes_applied.root_cause: Test used modal.getByRole('radio') which matched ALL radios (color + size). First product (25688608M) has only 1 color ('Ivory Multi') but 5 sizes. Clicking nth(1) clicked size '4' (already selected), so the image never changed.
fixes_applied.fix: Changed to target the Color radiogroup specifically using modal.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: /color/i }), then get radio buttons within that group. Added test.skip when < 2 color swatches are available.

fixes_applied.root_cause: Test iterated all radios flat, clicking only the first non-disabled one. This selected within a single variation group (e.g., color only), leaving the variation incomplete so the ATC button remained disabled.
fixes_applied.fix: Changed to iterate each radiogroup separately, selecting the first available option in each group (Color + Size), ensuring a complete variation is selected before clicking ATC.
